unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 5 - Area and Perimeter - Year 5-6 Maths.pptx
anchor: perimeter goes around the edge (add the sides); area covers the inside (length x width)

lessons.focus: Perimeter of rectangles and shapes with straight sides, including missing side lengths. Critical feature: add every side; find a missing side from the opposite sides. Review: probability (Week 4) and statistics (Week 3).

Area of rectangles with larger numbers, multiplying efficiently: split the long side, double and halve, or the written method. Critical feature: area = length x width, in square units. Review: statistics, angles, probability.

Area problems with division: a missing side is area divided by the known side; composite areas; remainders in context (round up when you must cover it all). Critical feature: decide what the answer means before you round. Review: angles, misleading graphs, probability.
